Contributors: American Bank Note Company; Richmond and Danville Railroad Company

Perspective map looking north from Florida covering the southern United States. Relief is shown by shading. Drainage, cities and towns, and the railroad network are indicated. Main lines appear in heavy red.
dct_title_s: Birds-eye-view of the Richmond & Danville Railroad and the Florida Central & Peninsular Systems and their connections
